prompt: If you (to pass) me the bird seed, I (to pay) for it.
explanation_ru: В if-части о будущем ставим настоящее время (pass), а в главной — will + инфинитив (I'll pay).

prompt: Soraya will open her book stall if the office ___ her a place in the market.
explanation_ru: После if не ставим will: If the office gives… will относится только к главной части (will open).

prompt: Carmen will show you how to make a tortilla if you (to come) on Sunday.
explanation_ru: В условии после if — Present Simple (come), даже если речь о воскресенье.

prompt: If I will find the owner's number, I will call him straight away.
answer: If I find the owner's number, I will call him straight away.
accepted_answers: If I find the owner's number, I will call him straight away.
If I find the owner's number, I'll call him straight away.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — will после if. В условии о будущем нужен Present Simple: If I find…

prompt: The tomatoes will get more sun if you (to plant) them here.
explanation_ru: После if о будущем — Present Simple (plant), will остаётся в главной части.

prompt: Lucia will carry the bags upstairs if you (to let) her.
explanation_ru: В if-части — Present Simple (let), will — только в главной части.

prompt: Match the halves.
pairs: If Farid gets a spare ticket,
he will watch the film with me.
he will turn his phone off.
If Farid has seen the film before,
he will not come with us.
explanation_ru: Сочетаем по форме и смыслу: If — возможное событие, When — уверенное, Unless — «если не», If + Present Perfect — уже завершённое к будущему моменту.

prompt: My baby cannot sleep by the door. The waiter says if I (to wait) a moment, he (to find) a quieter table near the window. I hope the baby sleeps better there.
explanation_ru: В if-части — Present Simple (wait), в главной — will + инфинитив (he'll find).

prompt: Our neighbours are short of chairs for their party. If they (to ask), I (to bring) some from my own flat. They will probably ask.
explanation_ru: После if — Present Simple (ask); результат — will (I'll bring).

prompt: An older man cannot read the questions on his form. Which sentence fits?
options: If you like, I will read the questions aloud for you.
If you will like, I read the questions aloud for you.
If you like, I read the questions aloud for you.
If you liked, I would read the questions aloud for you.
explanation_ru: Вежливое предложение о будущем — первое условное: If you like, I will read… Варианты с will после if и с Present Simple в главной части неверны.

prompt: We will not go to the sea if it (to rain) all weekend.
explanation_ru: В if-части о будущем — Present Simple (rains), несмотря на will not в главной части.

prompt: Elif will take the nearer job if it (to pay) more than the other one.
explanation_ru: После if — Present Simple (pays); will стоит в главной части (will take).

prompt: The team will not finish the wall painting if the paint (to run) out.
explanation_ru: В условии — Present Simple (runs); will not — в главной части.

prompt: Junho will sing with me if the song ___ on the list.
explanation_ru: После if не ставим will: If the song is on the list… will — только в главной части.

prompt: The class will not plant anything if the school (not / to buy) the seeds.
explanation_ru: В отрицательном if-условии — Present Simple: does not buy (doesn't buy).

prompt: I want to show my volcano project at the science fair. If my partner (to finish) the poster, I (to enter) it. If she (not / to finish) it, I will wait.
explanation_ru: После if — Present Simple (finishes / doesn't finish), в главной части — will (I'll enter).

prompt: If the shop has the coat, Sara ___ it.
explanation_ru: В главной части первого условного — will + инфинитив (will order), а не Present Simple.

prompt: Esen will join the running club if the training (to fit) her work shifts.
explanation_ru: После if — Present Simple (fits); will — в главной части.

prompt: I will launch my app when the test users like it. → If the test users like it, …
answer: If the test users like it, I will launch my app.
accepted_answers: If the test users like it, I will launch my app.
If the test users like it, I'll launch my app.
explanation_ru: When меняем на If: событие не гарантировано, поэтому условие и результат строим как первое условное.

prompt: Seda will not buy the bike if it (not / to fit) on the bus rack.
explanation_ru: В отрицательном if-условии — Present Simple: does not fit (doesn't fit).

prompt: Elsa wants to revise in the library. If the reading room (to stay) open late, she (to work) there. If it (not / to stay) open, she will study at home.
explanation_ru: После if — Present Simple (stays / doesn't stay); результат — will (she'll work).

prompt: Which group does each sentence belong to?

items.text: If it snows, we will stay at home.
If ice melts, it turns into water.
If the road is clear, we will drive to the mountains.
If you heat water, it boils.
If the weather is good, we will ski all day.
If I am cold, I put on a coat.

explanation_ru: Первое условное — возможное будущее (will + инфинитив); нулевое — общая истина (Present Simple в обеих частях).

prompt: Will Sofia get Tuesday off if a colleague (to agree) to swap shifts? If nobody does, she (to work) her normal hours.
explanation_ru: В вопросе условие после if остаётся в Present Simple (agrees); результат — will work.

prompt: Camille will open the shelter to visitors if she ___ enough helpers.
explanation_ru: После if — Present Simple (has), не will.

prompt: We are making spring rolls for the party. If we (not / to buy) the rice paper, we (not / to have) anything to wrap. If we (to go) to the shop, we (to get) it before it closes.
explanation_ru: В if-частях — Present Simple (don't buy, go), в главных — will (won't have, will get).

prompt: Ada will call the police if she ___ her insurance papers.
explanation_ru: После if — Present Simple (finds), не will.

prompt: Dimitri wants to put solar panels on his house, but he is still waiting for two prices. Which sentence fits?
options: He will choose the cheaper company if he gets the two prices.
He chooses the cheaper company if he will get the two prices.
He will choose the cheaper company if he got the two prices.
He will choose the cheaper company if he will get the two prices.
explanation_ru: Верное первое условное: If he gets… he will choose. Остальные используют will после if или Present Simple в главной части.

prompt: Minji will start decorating when the paint is back in stock. → If the paint is back in stock, …
answer: If the paint is back in stock, Minji will start decorating.
accepted_answers: If the paint is back in stock, Minji will start decorating.
If the paint is back in stock, Minji is going to start decorating.
explanation_ru: When (уверенность) меняем на If (возможность); в if-части Present Simple, в главной — will.

prompt: If we will get there before four, we will get the fish sandwiches.
answer: If we get there before four, we will get the fish sandwiches.
accepted_answers: If we get there before four, we will get the fish sandwiches.
If we get there before four, we'll get the fish sandwiches.
explanation_ru: Ошибка — will после if. Нужно: If we get there…, we will get…

prompt: Join the halves.
pairs: If you lend me your chairs,
I will bring them back after the party.
we will keep the party outside.
I will call you straight away.
explanation_ru: Сочетаем по форме и смыслу: If — возможное, When — уверенное, Unless — «если не», If + Present Perfect — уже сделанное к будущему моменту.

prompt: Build the sentence.
answer: If the clinic has a free slot, I will come early.
accepted_answers: If the clinic has a free slot, I will come early.
explanation_ru: Собираем первое условное: If + Present Simple, затем will + инфинитив.

prompt: Mehmet will open the pottery room if the lights are fixed.
answer: Mehmet will open the pottery room if the lights are fixed.
accepted_answers: Mehmet will open the pottery room if the lights are fixed.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: условие после if в Present Simple (are fixed), в главной части — will (will open).
